mapper.sql: COALESCE(a.old_display_value, a.old_value) AS old_value, COALESCE(a.new_display_value, a.new_value) AS new_value
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.project_id, i.issue_key, i.title, i.description, i.issue_type, i.status_id, i.priority, i.assignee_id, i.reporter_id, i.sprint_id, i.parent_id, i.due_date, i.estimated_hours, i.spent_hours, i.derived_spent_hours, i.derived_estimated_hours, i.resolved_at, i.created_at, i.updated_at, i.version, i.visibility, p.name AS project_name, p.status AS project_status, s.name AS status_name, s.code AS status_code, s.color AS status_color, s.category AS status_category, s.is_default AS status_is_default, s.is_closed AS status_is_closed, s.display_name AS status_display_name, a.display_name AS assignee_name, a.avatar_url AS assignee_avatar_url, r.display_name AS reporter_name, creator.id AS created_by_id, creator.display_name AS created_by_name, updater.id AS updated_by_id, updater.display_name AS updated_by_name, sp.name AS sprint_name, sp.status AS sprint_status, pi.issue_key AS parent_key FROM issue i LEFT JOIN project p ON p.id = i.project_id LEFT JOIN issue_status s ON s.id = i.status_id LEFT JOIN sys_user a ON a.id = i.assignee_id LEFT JOIN sys_user r ON r.id = i.reporter_id LEFT JOIN sys_user creator ON creator.id = i.created_by LEFT JOIN sys_user updater ON updater.id = i.updated_by LEFT JOIN sprint sp ON sp.id = i.sprint_id LEFT JOIN issue pi ON pi.id = i.parent_id AND pi.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE i.id = #{id} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT c.id, c.issue_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.source, c.deleted_at, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.visible_to_group_ids, u.display_name AS user_name, u.avatar_url AS user_avatar FROM issue_comment c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.issue_id = #{issueId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC

SELECT a.id, a.issue_id, a.user_id, a.action, a.field_name, , a.detail, a.source, a.created_at, u.display_name AS user_name, u.avatar_url AS user_avatar FROM issue_activity a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE a.issue_id = #{issueId}
AND NOT (a.old_value IS NOT NULL AND a.new_value IS NOT NULL AND a.old_value = a.new_value) ORDER BY a.created_at ASC

SELECT a.id, a.issue_id, a.user_id, a.action, a.field_name, , a.detail, a.source, a.created_at, u.display_name AS user_name, u.avatar_url AS user_avatar FROM issue_activity a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE a.issue_id = #{issueId} AND NOT (a.old_value IS NOT NULL AND a.new_value IS NOT NULL AND a.old_value = a.new_value) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issue_activity a WHERE a.issue_id = #{issueId} AND NOT (a.old_value IS NOT NULL AND a.new_value IS NOT NULL AND a.old_value = a.new_value)

SELECT i.id, i.project_id, i.issue_key, i.title, i.issue_type, i.priority, i.deleted_at, a.display_name AS assignee_name, d.display_name AS deleted_by_name FROM issue i LEFT JOIN sys_user a ON a.id = i.assignee_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT user_id FROM issue_activity WHERE issue_id = i.id AND action = 'deleted' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) act ON true LEFT JOIN sys_user d ON d.id = act.user_id WHERE i.project_id = #{projectId} AND i.deleted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.deleted_at DESC
SELECT i.id, i.project_id, i.issue_key, i.title, i.issue_type, i.priority, i.deleted_at, i.assignee_id, i.reporter_id, i.sprint_id, i.status_id, i.parent_id FROM issue i WHERE i.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE issue SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM issue WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.issue_key, i.title, i.issue_type, i.priority, COALESCE(s.display_name, s.name) AS status_name, s.color AS status_color, s.category AS status_category, u.display_name AS assignee_name FROM issue i LEFT JOIN issue_status s ON s.id = i.status_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = i.assignee_id WHERE i.parent_id = #{parentId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY i.created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE issue SET parent_id = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE parent_id = #{parentId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT status_id FROM issue WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT status_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM issue WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY status_id
SELECT priority, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM issue WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY priority

WITH issue_counts AS ( SELECT status_id, COUNT(*) AS issue_count, COALESCE(SUM(estimated_hours), 0) AS total_estimation FROM issue WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY status_id ), workflow_statuses AS ( SELECT DISTINCT status_id FROM ( SELECT old_status_id AS status_id FROM workflow_transition WHERE project_id = #{projectId} OR project_id IS NULL UNION SELECT new_status_id AS status_id FROM workflow_transition WHERE project_id = #{projectId} OR project_id IS NULL ) t ) SELECT s.id AS status_id, COALESCE(ic.issue_count, 0) AS issue_count, COALESCE(ic.total_estimation, 0) AS total_estimation, (ws.status_id IS NOT NULL) AS in_workflow FROM issue_status s LEFT JOIN issue_counts ic ON ic.status_id = s.id LEFT JOIN workflow_statuses ws ON ws.status_id = s.id
SELECT id, created_at, resolved_at FROM issue WHERE sprint_id = #{sprintId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT (issue_type = 'Epic' AND child_count > 0)
